name: Preach
tagline: One passage of scripture and a short encouragement, daily
description: A quiet daily habit rather than a study course. Each day it sends a single passage of scripture, quoted as it stands, with a few lines of encouragement written around it. The tone stays steady and undramatic, meant for someone leaning on it for perspective and a bit of strength rather than for counsel or crisis help.
author: XO
